name: odm-orthophoto-p1
description: OpenDroneMap odm_orthophoto (GIT_TAG 355) with the VicTerra P0 int32-overflow fix, built via GitHub Actions for a native odm_orthophoto.exe. Feature set trimmed to exactly what src/OdmOrthoPhoto.cpp and CMakeLists.txt actually link against (opencv_core/imgproc/highgui/photo + gdal's core raster path) -- NOT ODM's full ~30-dependency SuperBuild list, most of which belongs to other ODM components.
